title: Viktor Oddy — Look circle: spin the ring, pick a fit, receipt prints down
note: A minimalist fashion site for NOWHERE-: ten models in different outfits stand in a ring around large black serif text reading Stay out of the loop; the ring slowly rotates, pick one and it comes forward, then a receipt prints down from the top. Caption: Fable 5.2 + GPT Image 2.6 is ridiculous for fashion sites. Her steal: the ring-of-looks as a browsing device for her future clothing brand, and the receipt print-down as a tactile checkout moment. Free build prompt: https://motionsites.ai/?prompt=look-circle
